topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Walking down memory lane, I can't help but reminisce as I stroll past the old school building, the bricks familiar yet weathered by time. The bell rings, echoing familiarly, and there they are, my child mingling with the crowd, a sprinkle of excitement in the air. Our eyes meet, and I nod, a silent acknowledgment. I see them, the way they look at the world, so much like when I was young. The teacher greets them, and it's her, still standing tall, the same warm smile lining her face. It's a small world, isn't it? The connection feels right, a reassuring thread back to my own youth.
